{{Top|leg}}
'''Arven Ershall''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] Ershall was part of [[Satele Shan]]'s forces that entered into a temporary alliance with [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]] loyal to [[Darth Marr]]. Ershall was initially skeptical about the truce.<ref name="Commandant Iven">{{TORcite|type=message|Commandant Iven|Lt. Ershall}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Arven Ershall was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', where Ershall sends Imperial players a message if they choose to have Satele Shan interrogate [[Iven]] instead of Marr.
